svg.aria-label: Timeline of one example day with the night from 22:00 to 07:00. Night Shift on Automatic is on for the night. Extra Warmth is 20 percent all day, and Warmer at night adds 13 points for the night, 33 percent, rising and falling over half an hour. Grayscale stays as you set it, day and night.
